factor_name: Volatility-Scaled Three-Day Reversal in High Dispersion

calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, invert its trailing three-day return and scale by its own trailing 20-day daily-return volatility. Center and standardize cross-sectionally, and retain the signal only on dates when cross-asset daily-return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-observation median. The signal uses information available at the prior completed day for forward-return validation.

validation.universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; observation-only macro series excluded
validation.decay_notes: Positive at 1, 5, and 10 trading days; strongest observed at 5 days. Daily admission passes benchmark absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Recent regime is weaker and should be monitored.
validation.regime_notes: Positive IC in all three broad regimes, with conservative interpretation warranted because the cross-section has only 15 instruments and the signal is selective.
